recent_observations.market_summary: U.S. equities staged a selective risk-on rebound after easing U.S.-Iran tension and renewed mega-cap/AI buying: SPY finished up about 1.7%, QQQ about 2.5%, and DIA about 0.8%, while IWM slipped slightly. VIX closed in the high-17s/near 18 area, so fear compressed but breadth was not clean enough to treat every growth setup as approved.
key_drivers: U.S.-Iran de-escalation and lower volatility encouraged a rebound after the S&P 500 and Nasdaq had been on five-day losing streaks.
Mega-cap technology, AI, memory/storage, satellite, and cable/communications headlines drove the tape more than broad participation.
Thursday jobs data and a holiday-shortened week kept macro risk in front of the market despite the strong index close.

thesis_review.thesis: Neutral relief regime: geopolitical de-escalation can stabilize indexes, but longs should be conditional because QQQ/breadth repair was not proven in the morning.
thesis_review.evidence: The market did repair aggressively in headline indexes, especially QQQ, while IWM lagged and sector participation was mixed; the neutral morning label was directionally cautious but under-called the magnitude of the tech rebound.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: When index momentum accelerates and VIX compresses, avoid staying mechanically neutral, but still require symbol-level proof before buying crowded setups.

thesis_review.thesis: AVAV can work into after-close earnings if it holds the 138 area with VWAP support and position size stays small.
thesis_review.evidence: AVAV traded above the 138.50 plan intraday and the system bought 71 shares at 139.72 near the close, but the earnings catalyst had not resolved in the available profile snapshot and post-close source checks mainly confirmed the scheduled call.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: The price was fair versus the plan, but entering minutes before a binary earnings event leaves little room to react; event-gated buys need a stricter late-day cutoff or explicit earnings-hold rule.

thesis_review.thesis: WDC/MU storage and memory leadership needs digestion, base/VWAP confirmation, and no MU group drag before new long exposure.
thesis_review.evidence: MU and QCOM caution was reasonable, but WDC reclaimed and then closed around 651.75, far above the 602 plan and near the session high, making the blanket repair-watch stance too conservative for the strongest storage leader.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Missing explicit VWAP data should not automatically block a liquid leader when price reclaims the trigger, sector narrative is active, and the stock is closing on relative strength.

thesis_review.thesis: NKE should remain event-watch only until June 30 earnings clear and price holds above 41 with constructive guidance reaction.
thesis_review.evidence: NKE closed near 41.48 and held above the reference area, but the catalyst remains tomorrow after the close, so skipping pre-event exposure respected the morning thesis.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: For mixed-turnaround earnings, a technically fair price before the print is still not a clean entry unless the plan explicitly accepts gap risk.

thesis_review.thesis: CMCSA/CHTR should not be chased after large cable/SpaceX/M&A headline gaps without regular-session confirmation.
thesis_review.evidence: CHTR and CMCSA were major movers, but both had very wide intraday ranges; CHTR faded from a 171.50 high to 146.16 and CMCSA faded from 29.66 to 24.19, validating the do-not-chase label.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Gap headlines tied to speculative M&A or partnership narratives need opening-range risk control because headline buyers can be late even on a green close.

trades_review.assessment: The entry was close to the planned level and sized near 10%, but buying immediately before after-close earnings makes the thesis unproven rather than a clean confirmed swing.

patterns_detected.notes: CHTR and CMCSA finished green but far below intraday highs after SpaceX/M&A headlines, validating the do-not-chase bucket.

confidence_calibration.avoid_confidence_assessment: High avoid confidence worked for QURE and the cable chase risk, but it failed on WDC because missing VWAP evidence was overweighted against live price reclaim and relative strength.
confidence_calibration.assessment: Confidence was directionally useful for filtering stale/retired setups, but not calibrated enough to distinguish unavailable confirmation data from actual failed confirmation.

decision_journal_review.skipped_setups_assessment: Most skips were correct: NKE was still pre-earnings, QURE was retired, QCOM lacked repair, and CMCSA/CHTR were chase-risk headlines. WDC was the clear missed winner because the system stayed too rigid on VWAP/base proof after price reclaimed the planned level.
decision_journal_review.approved_setups_assessment: AVAV was approved with moderate conviction and small sizing, but the approval came too close to after-close earnings for a clean swing entry unless the strategy explicitly accepts binary event risk.
decision_journal_review.data_quality_notes: The analyst provider returned zero items, several decisions had only two sources, and missing explicit VWAP/relative-strength fields caused the monitor to treat unknown confirmation as failed confirmation.

missed_opportunities.why_missed: Repair-watch logic required explicit VWAP and MU-drag relief even after WDC reclaimed the plan and showed clear storage-leader relative strength.
The screen captured SpaceX/telecom disruption through CHTR/CMCSA but did not map the same satellite-mobile theme to the cleaner high-beta winner.
Rocket Lab's Iridium acquisition was a large company-specific aerospace/satellite catalyst outside the morning watchlist.
PLTR was a best-opportunity buy candidate but never entered the monitor's final execution set despite meeting the broad AI/software rebound theme.

invalidation_signals: AI-memory headlines reverse into sector distribution

next_session_theses.theory: The SpaceX/mobile/satellite theme can continue if ASTS, RKLB, and CHTR hold above post-news ranges, but after today's extension the only acceptable long entries are pullbacks or retests, not opening chases.

recent_observations.forward_outlook: Tomorrow starts with an open AVAV event-risk position and a market that looks risk-on in indexes but not uniformly broad. Manage AVAV around the post-earnings opening range, watch WDC only on a retest after its missed breakout, keep NKE gated until its June 30 print, and avoid chasing extended SpaceX/satellite/cable winners unless they build a new base.
lessons: Missing explicit VWAP data is not the same as failed VWAP confirmation; for liquid leaders like WDC, add a relative-strength override when price reclaims the plan and closes near highs.
Do not initiate a new earnings-catalyst long in the final minutes before the report unless the trade plan explicitly says to hold through the print.
A strong QQQ rebound with falling VIX can turn a neutral morning into a risk-on afternoon, but small-cap lag means entries still need symbol-level confirmation.
Speculative M&A or partnership gaps can close green while still punishing late buyers; judge chase risk by intraday range fade, not just closing return.

recent_observations.market_summary: The morning relief-rally setup turned into a mixed, choppy rotation day: the Dow pushed above 52,000 while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq faded as crowded tech and chip momentum cooled. VIX stayed contained near the mid-teens and oil fell on US-Iran/Strait of Hormuz relief, but the tape punished extended AI and fintech headlines into the Fed decision.
key_drivers: US-Iran/Strait of Hormuz relief kept oil lower and volatility contained, supporting cyclicals and the Dow.
Fed-decision risk and crowding after a three-day relief rally drove profit-taking in Nasdaq, chips, and speculative fintech.
Stock-specific AI/storage and restructuring headlines produced sharp dispersion rather than broad risk-on follow-through.

thesis_review.thesis: Relief from energy/geopolitical stress should keep buyers engaged in liquid growth and industrial/defense-adjacent names if oil stays contained, VIX remains near the mid-teens, and indexes hold the post-relief breakout range.
thesis_review.evidence: Oil and VIX confirmed the relief inputs, but Nasdaq and S&P faded while the monitored longs slipped below their execution zones by the afternoon.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Macro relief alone is not enough after a three-day squeeze; require relative-strength and VWAP confirmation before treating a headline gap as swingable.

thesis_review.thesis: QCOM can extend if Tenstorrent AI-chip speculation and semiconductor risk appetite hold while price stays above post-news support.
thesis_review.evidence: QCOM opened strong but later traded below the 224.00-229.50 buy range and under the 220.50 stop reference, while semiconductor leadership faded.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: The morning buy range was fair only early; once QCOM lost the planned support zone, the catalyst became a crowded headline rather than a valid long setup.

thesis_review.thesis: GM can grind higher if Lockheed/defense-production headlines create a new institutional narrative while lower oil supports autos.
thesis_review.evidence: GM initially sat in the 84.00-86.00 band but never provided the required VWAP confirmation and later fell below the entry window as market tone deteriorated.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: For slower industrial narratives, a first-hour VWAP hold matters; buying the headline without that hold would have converted a fair setup into a late chase.

thesis_review.thesis: WDC and MU should be watched for AI/storage continuation only after digestion because the gap was crowded.
thesis_review.evidence: WDC remained a standout mover but MU reversed lower and broader chip breadth weakened, validating the decision to avoid chasing the group at the open.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Extended AI/storage leaders can still work, but the system should demand pullback-or-base entries when crowding risk is explicitly high.

thesis_review.thesis: HOOD can benefit if risk appetite and trading activity remain strong, but layoffs alone are insufficient for a high-conviction buy.
thesis_review.evidence: HOOD stayed far below the 124 watch reference and the layoff narrative did not create a durable opening-range hold.
thesis_review.entry_quality_lesson: Efficiency headlines need market-confirmed accumulation; workforce cuts are not automatically bullish when fintech beta is fading.

The TSMC/Amkor packaging deal was not in the morning catalyst screen, so the system missed a cleaner company-specific semiconductor winner while watching weaker QCOM.

next_session_theses.name: fed_chop_cash_filter
next_session_theses.theory: If the Fed reaction lifts yields or broadens tech selling, the best long-only action is to stay mostly cash and only trade names with company-specific strength that hold opening ranges.

recent_observations.forward_outlook: Tomorrow should be treated as a Fed-reaction and post-relief-chop session. Favor cash unless QCOM repairs above its failed support, GM reclaims the defense-headline band with VWAP support, or storage leaders digest instead of extending; avoid new longs in headline names that gap without first-hour confirmation.
lessons: When a morning thesis says crowding is medium or high, a failed VWAP check should downgrade a buy candidate to avoid, not merely watch with stale bullish framing.
Contained VIX and lower oil can coexist with Nasdaq weakness; regime labels need breadth and index-relative confirmation before approving growth longs.
For long-only execution, no trade is a positive outcome when every candidate fails its own price and confirmation gates.

weekly_reviews.market_summary: The holiday-shortened week ended higher for major indexes, with outside research showing gains concentrated in semiconductors, memory, AI infrastructure, industrials, and small caps while oil and energy lagged sharply. That confirmed the profile's early macro relief thesis, but daily observations were right to call the actionable tape neutral because many watched longs lacked breadth, VWAP, peer, or price-range confirmation. VIX stayed contained in the mid-teens into the week ending 2026-06-19, but the Fed's less friendly rate message and crowded AI leadership made chasing gaps unattractive. The best process outcome was staying flat when QCOM, GM, HOOD, and later MU did not satisfy their execution gates.

worst_trade.lesson: No losing trade occurred; the key lesson is to keep failed catalyst gaps on avoid or repair-watch status until price, VWAP, and peer confirmation all repair.

momentum.notes: Momentum existed in AI, memory, and semiconductor names, but profile candidates were mixed: QCOM failed below its planned range on 2026-06-16, HOOD had unconfirmed momentum, and MU was only eligible if VWAP and peer confirmation appeared.

mean_reversion.notes: No mean-reversion trade fired and the profile did not document a qualified reversal setup.

trend.notes: No trend-following trade fired; broad index gains were real, but monitored names did not provide clean trend entries inside the profile's gates.

volume_breakout.notes: No volume-breakout trade fired; elevated volume in HOOD was explicitly not enough without opening-range and fintech/crypto confirmation.

support_resistance.notes: Support and range gates worked as risk filters: QCOM below 220.50, GM below 84.00-86.00, and HOOD below plan references all stayed watch-only instead of becoming late entries.

vwap.notes: VWAP confirmation repeatedly blocked low-quality entries in GM, QCOM, HOOD, and MU. It reduced trade count to zero, but that matched the evidence from failed or incomplete setups.

relative_strength.notes: Peer and index confirmation requirements were useful: semiconductor breadth and SMH confirmation were needed for QCOM/MU, while fintech and crypto confirmation were needed for HOOD and were not proven.

news_catalyst.notes: News generated useful watchlist ideas, but several headlines were crowded or incomplete. The profile correctly avoided QCOM, GM, and HOOD, but missed cleaner catalysts in MRNA, SPCX, and AMKR.

Add FDA/regulatory, off-cycle earnings, and supplier-deal scans to the morning catalyst screen so healthcare and cleaner company-specific movers are not missed on mixed index days.

rules: Stay mostly cash when candidate-specific gates fail in a risk_off tape.

proposals.title: Add afternoon regime escalation check
proposals.description: The morning neutral call was prudent, but QQQ and SPY strengthened materially while VIX fell. The monitor should reclassify neutral-to-risk-on when index gains, VIX compression, and leader close-near-high behavior align, while still respecting symbol gates.
proposals.expected_impact: Allows the system to participate in confirmed afternoon trend days without abandoning entry discipline.

proposals.title: Map headline themes to adjacent liquid winners
proposals.description: The system saw SpaceX and cable headlines through CHTR/CMCSA but missed ASTS and RKLB, the cleaner satellite/aerospace momentum winners. Theme extraction should expand watch candidates to adjacent liquid tickers with confirmed volume.
proposals.expected_impact: Improves capture of real top movers when the original headline names are extended or messy.

proposals.title: Add late-day earnings-entry cutoff
proposals.description: AVAV was bought minutes before its scheduled after-close earnings call. Event setups should require an explicit hold-through-earnings flag or block new entries in the final 30 minutes before a binary report.
proposals.expected_impact: Prevents technically fair entries from becoming unmanaged overnight event bets.

proposals.title: Distinguish missing VWAP from failed VWAP
proposals.description: WDC was skipped because VWAP support was not shown, yet it reclaimed the plan and closed far above target. The monitor should mark unavailable VWAP/relative-strength evidence as unknown and apply alternate checks such as close-near-high, sector leadership, and trigger reclaim.
proposals.expected_impact: Would have kept WDC eligible after reclaim instead of treating absent confirmation as a blocker.

proposals.title: Track missed mover reason codes
proposals.description: Missed opportunities came from regulatory catalysts, newly public mega-cap momentum, and overlooked semiconductor packaging news. Store missed-mover reason codes so screening gaps can be measured over multiple reflections.
proposals.expected_impact: Turns anecdotal missed opportunities into a prioritized data-source backlog.

proposals.title: Require breadth confirmation for risk-on labels
proposals.description: The morning regime was risk_on because oil and VIX improved, but the close was mixed with Nasdaq weakness. Regime classification should require breadth, QQQ/SPY behavior, and sector participation before enabling growth-stock buys.
proposals.expected_impact: Avoids overallocating to crowded growth names during relief rallies that rotate into Dow cyclicals or defensives.

proposals.title: Add FDA and company-specific event mover scan
proposals.description: The system missed Moderna's large FDA-briefing-document move while watching weaker headline setups. The morning screen should include FDA calendars, briefing documents, and same-day regulatory catalysts for liquid healthcare names.
proposals.expected_impact: Broadens opportunity capture beyond AI and macro-relief themes, especially on mixed index days where healthcare leads.

proposals.title: Auto-downgrade failed buy ranges after stop-reference breach
proposals.description: QCOM moved from inside/near the buy range to below the planned stop reference, but remained in the same watch loop. A candidate that trades below its planned stop before entry should require a fresh thesis and a new setup before it can be considered again.
proposals.expected_impact: Reduces temptation to bottom-fish failed catalyst gaps and keeps the system from recycling invalidated entries.
